items.title: What Does Nike (NKE) Cookie Stuffing Exposure Mean For Investors?
items.summary: NIKE (NYSE:NKE) is linked to an alleged "cookie stuffing" scheme involving e-commerce startup Phia that may have affected how affiliate sales were tracked on Nike's site. Phia, co-founded by Bill Gates' daughter, is accused of inserting tracking cookies without valid referrals, potentially distorting affiliate revenue attribution for Nike.
